name: Maltese Fur-Con
description: The Maltese Fur-Con was a furry convention held in Boston, Massachusetts, in August 2014. It took a mystery-themed approach, weaving a plot through the convention areas that attendees could follow by putting clues together, alongside an art show, vendors and panels. A second edition was announced for August 2015 in Waltham, but it was not held.
